```{python}
#| label: fig-history-timeline
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Timeline of key milestones in semiconductor history."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

events = [
    (1874, 'Braun discovers\nrectification (diode)', 0.5, 'center'),
    (1926, 'Lilienfeld patents\nthe FET', -0.5, 'center'),
    (1947, 'First transistor (BJT)\nat Bell Labs', 1.0, 'center'),
    (1958, 'Kilby: first\nsolid-state circuit', -1.0, 'right'),
    (1960, 'Noyce: first monolithic IC;\nKahng/Atalla: first MOSFET', 1.7,
     'right'),
    (1963, 'Wanlass/Sah\ninvent CMOS', -1.2, 'left'),
    (1964, 'Widlar: first integrated\nop-amp (µA702)', 1.15, 'left'),
    (1965, "Moore's law", -0.6, 'left'),
    (2006, "First billion-transistor\nchip (Intel Itanium 2)", 0.8, 'center'),
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8 , 3.8))
ax.axhline(0, color='k', lw=1.2)
for year, label, y, ha in events:
    up = (y > 0)
    ax.plot([year, year], [0, y], color='tab:blue', lw=1)
    ax.plot(year, 0, 'o', color='tab:blue', ms=5)
    dx = {'center': 0, 'left': 1.5, 'right': -1.5}[ha]
    ax.text(year + dx, y + (0.08 if up else -0.08), f'{year}\n{label}',
            ha=ha, va='bottom' if up else 'top', fontsize=8)

ax.set_xlim(1865, 2010)
ax.set_ylim(-2.1, 2.5)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xticks([1875, 1900, 1925, 1950, 1975, 2000])
ax.spines[['left', 'right', 'top']].set_visible(False)
ax.set_xlabel('Year')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
